en: The postcard features a collage of nighttime photographs, principally showing modernist, brightly lit hotels, including one with a neon sign reading 'Astoria' and another labeled 'Hotel Berlin.' The top of the postcard has text in Cyrillic. The back of the postcard contains multilingual text describing 'Nights in Zlatni Piassatsi,' and publication details in Bulgarian.
